protocol.boundary_metric: X displacement at equal Y,Z, not Hausdorff distance
protocol.maximum_metric: maximum over the sampled independent evaluation points
protocol.payload: stored model arrays and minimal metadata, excluding runtime overhead
protocol.memory: per-process peak RSS, including Python, libraries, and temporaries
protocol.timing: single run construction timing; not a statistical speed ranking
protocol.sampling: P and T use identical sidewall observation nodes; V samples cell centres
protocol.scope: smooth synthetic asymmetric cross-sections and height/length-dependent sidewalls
protocol.caveat: this smooth fixed-topology reference favors a smooth interpolation prior
